newsitem.title: GREECE: MACEDONIA-THRACE BANK'S AGM FAILS TO MEET QUORUM.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA-THRACE BANK'S AGM FAILS TO MEET QUORUM.

text.p: Macedonia-Thrace Bank's repeat shareholders meeting on June 10 failed to reach the required quorum, the bank said.
The shareholders meeting would have considered a bonus share issue and the revision of certain articles of the bank's corporate charter.
The quorum required the presence of shareholders making up a minimum 50 percent of the bank's share capital but present were only 34.4 percent, it said.
A second repeat shareholders meeting will take place June 25 at 12:00 local in Thessaloniki at Macedonia-Thrace bank's new building at Ethikis Amynis 5-7, it said.
